company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, founder-led transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It provides intercity bus and growing passenger-rail services across Central Europe, supported by online booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model relies on regional partners to operate many routes while Corvale manages the platform, network planning and brand.

The company is technology-first and engineering-led, with teams owning their systems end to end. Strategic priorities include expanding the use of data and machine learning, growing sustainably and introducing a new train fleet later this decade.

Corvale’s stated values are **“Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey.”** It describes its culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas, with international teams working toward shared goals and solving problems together. Employees are encouraged to take ownership of their work and career development.

The company has received workplace culture awards based on employee surveys, including recognition for innovation, work-life flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. It says it continues to act on employee feedback. Employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits; many technology roles are also open to independent contractors.
